text: As a member of the Federation of Canadian Municipalities (FCM) Standing Committee on Municipal Finance & Intergovernmental Arrangements, I have championed the need for a Canada-wide approach to ensure municipalities are protected from cyber threats. At the September 2020 meeting of the FCM Board of Directors, municipal leaders determined further work is required to address the cyber security threat to Canada's local governments. At my request, FCM will be calling on the federal government to create a municipally-focused cyber security certification program. This will be done in collaboration with municipal governments, and address the need for federal support. A municipal cyber security certification program is one step to help enable municipalities to further their cyber risk management, and overcome limited financial resources, and operational constraints.
